findings.summary: The criterion 1 test skips the run.rs code that builds the brief inputs
findings.evidence: run.rs turns TreeRetrySeed into briefs::RetrySeed by copying fields one at a time (lines 431-436). The plan's criterion 1 test is in reading.rs and builds the RetrySeed itself. If run.rs left out must_address, or left retry_findings unset in the (None, None) arm, that test would still pass. Fix: Add an end-to-end check: run a real 'try again on <job>' job through run_job and assert on the stored producer brief. Alternatively, move the conversion into a function in reading.rs or briefs.rs that run.rs calls and the test also calls.

findings.summary: The plan does not say when the unseeded path applies
findings.evidence: resume is only computed when pinned is None. The plan calls retry_findings when both retry_seed and resume are None. That includes pinned jobs and jobs whose tree seed was refused because the base changed. A retry that resumes from a timeout gets no must-address block. Fix: State that retry_findings is used whenever no tree seed is used, including when the base changed and for pinned jobs. Confirm, or test, that a timed-out job has no verification findings to carry.

'A test asserts both briefs carry a finding regardless of any later round' has no clear observable. Fix: Drop it, or say exactly what it does. For example: a job whose later rounds show the finding fixed still carries it into the retry brief.

findings.summary: The extra files are compiler-forced literal updates
findings.evidence: Athena flagged these files as outside the deliverables. Adding the new fields breaks struct literals in these files, and serde defaults do not help Rust literals. Fix: Keep them, and say in the change description that the edits are mechanical.
findings.location: Files: status.rs, proposals.rs, labeled.rs, tests/review.rs, tests/labeled.rs, tests/proposals.rs

summary: I read reading.rs, jev.rs, run.rs and briefs.rs in the snapshot, and grepped for verify::finding_blocks and the job_plan test. The plan's claims match the code. parse_response (jev.rs:147) rejects the whole reply when any answer is missing. carry only feeds the reader brief. The producer brief carries findings only in the tree-seeded RetrySeed path (run.rs:430), and that list is unlabelled. tree_retry_seed and carry both format findings with the same inline code. finding_blocks exists, and the planning-stopped prefix is at run.rs:553. So the root cause is in the right place: one shared selector and formatter fixes both paths. Making only the new question optional in the real parser is right, and the introspection fields fit the design. Each demonstration would fail without its behavior. One gap is minor: the criterion 1 test bypasses the field mapping in run.rs. None of the findings is blocker or major, so I accept.
